children: Sui said on X that farmers selling corn and airlines locking in fuel prices three years ahead cannot run their businesses by guessing price movements, and that futures were created for that purpose. title: Sui Says CME Group Micro Futures Can Cover SUI and Sui Ecosystem DeFi
